stories.title: Pct. 4: Crews battle heavy flames at northwest Harris County home
stories.summary: Firefighters are battling a house fire on Brookside Forest Drive in northwest Harris County. Authorities said everyone inside escaped safely.

stories.title: 'It sounded like an explosion' | Train derailment rattles Houston neighborhood ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: About 10 railcars derailed Wednesday night, rattling Houston neighbors and prompting a hazmat response. Officials confirmed the railcars were empty.

stories.title: 7-year-old critically injured in three-vehicle crash in northwest Houston, police say
stories.summary: A 7-year-old was flown to a hospital in critical condition following a three-vehicle crash at Hammerly Boulevard and Beltway 8, Houston police said.

stories.title: Union Pacific train derails in Houston’s Fifth Ward
stories.summary: Union Pacific said cleanup is underway and an investigation into the incident is underway.

stories.title: Katy boy, 9, to receive life-saving kidney transplant from stranger after unlikely match
stories.summary: The chance a non-family member would be a match is 1%

stories.title: Pearland HS band raises $350,000 to stay in NYC for rescheduled Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: More than 500 band and color guard students will stay for Saturday’s parade after supporters met the goal to cover unexpected travel costs.

stories.title: Sheriff: Man dies after being found unresponsive in Katy-area store parking lot
stories.summary: An elderly man died after suffering an apparent heart attack in the Katy area. Deputies ruled out a pedestrian crash.

stories.title: Houston in talks to host Essence Festival after its departure from New Orleans
stories.summary: Houston is exploring a multiyear partnership with Essence’s owner after organizers said the festival will not return to New Orleans in 2027.

stories.title: They’re studying engineering and medicine. They’re also building needed medical supplies for Houstonians
stories.summary: Through the university’s e-NABLE chapter, students build upper-limb prosthetics and provide free repairs and replacements.

stories.title: Thanksgiving travelers hit Texas roads as holiday traffic builds
stories.summary: Houston-area travelers are navigating traffic and making Buc-ee’s stops as millions of Texans hit the road for Thanksgiving.

stories.title: ‘She’s not coming back’ | Mothers seek answers after best friends, 15 and 16, die in Aldine
stories.summary: The girls’ mothers are seeking answers about their final hours. A man faces an evading arrest charge but has not been charged in either death.

stories.title: New $29.8 million sea turtle hospital coming to Galveston’s Texas A&M campus
stories.summary: The hospital will expand Texas A&M at Galveston’s rescue and rehabilitation efforts, with space for up to 30 turtles at a time.
